newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil 1996 deficit at 14.3 bln reais -- newspaper.
newsitem.headline: Brazil 1996 deficit at 14.3 bln reais -- newspaper.

text.p: Brazil's 1996 public sector deficit should amount to 14.3 billion reais ($13.75 billion) according to unofficial figures, a newspaper said.
This compares with a 1995 public sector gap of 11.3 billion reais ($10.87 billion) and represents a 26.55 percent increase, Folha de Sao Paulo said.
The newspaper said the main factor behind the increased deficit was the interest paid on internal and external debt.
((-- Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151))
